name: remcord
description: Remcord is a custom client designed to enhance your Discord experience while keeping everything lightweight.

scripts.build: pnpm build:plugins && rolldown -c rolldown.config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/copyVenmic.ts
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./tests/register-ts.mjs --test tests/screenshare-previews.test.ts tests/rpc-blacklist-cache.test.ts tests/settings-scroll-restoration.test.ts tests/shelter-plugin-lifecycle.test.ts tests/shelter-rpc-listen.test.ts tests/native-folders-dispatch.test.ts tests/native-themes-dispatch.test.ts tests/native-settings-dispatch.test.ts tests/quickcss-editor-handoff.test.ts tests/native-backup-dispatch.test.ts tests/theme-import.test.ts tests/titlebar-document-title.test.ts tests/titlebar-topband-drag.test.ts tests/update-feed.test.ts tests/custom-bundles.test.ts tests/meta-repo.test.ts tests/arrpc-vendor.test.ts tests/gallery.test.ts
scripts.CIbuild: pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux zip && electron-builder --windows zip && electron-builder --macos zip
